name: navbar-fixed
title: Navbar Fixed
description: Full-width top bar that sticks or pins to the viewport, with links, a quiet action and a filled call to action.

props.name: links
props.type: { label: string; href: string; current?: boolean }[]
props.description: Main links. The current one gets aria-current.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: Quiet link before the call to action.

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: Filled call to action at the end.

props.name: position
props.description: How the bar stays in view.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the nav landmark.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
